in_marathi.name: Vishakha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishakha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Vishakha is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. She is depicted holding a lotus and a book, symbolizing learning and enlightenment. Vishakha is revered for her power to bestow intelligence and knowledge upon her devotees.

in_bengali.name: Vishakha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishakha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Vishakha is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. She is depicted holding a lotus and a book, symbolizing learning and enlightenment. Vishakha is revered for her power to bestow intelligence and knowledge upon her devotees.
